title: 恐龙会游泳吗
subtitle: 河底留下的划痕
character: wearing a river blue t-shirt, sand beige shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible strokes and layered hatching, river blue, silt grey and warm sand

pages.zh:
河边这块大石头上，
有一道一道的痕。
不是脚印，
是三条一组的划痕。
爸爸说，恐龙留的。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy beside a large flat rock covered in rows of three long scratch marks, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open in surprise.

pages.zh:
脚印是整只脚踩的，
又深又清楚。
这些划痕却很浅，
只有爪尖那么宽，
像用叉子刮过。

先看看真正的脚印。
三个脚趾，
一个脚跟，
稳稳踩在软泥里，
边上还堆起一圈泥。
pages.scene: One deep three-toed dinosaur track pressed into soft mud on a cream background with a low ridge of mud pushed up all around its edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
河底的划痕不一样。
每一组三条，
又细又直，
一组接着一组，
排出长长的一串。

原来它是浮着的。
水把身子托起来，
只有爪尖
够得着河底，
一蹬一蹬往前走。
pages.scene: One large two-legged dinosaur floating in a river with most of its body under the water and only the tips of its toes touching the river bottom, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水有多深呢？
比它的腿还深，
一直没到肚子。
脚踩不实，
只能用爪尖点着走。

有意思的是，
这一串划痕
并不是笔直的。
它一点点偏向一边，
是水把它推歪了。
pages.scene: One long line of toe-tip scratch marks on a river bottom running forwards but sloping towards one side, seen from directly above. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
在岸上走，
一步就是一步。
在水里蹬一下，
身子能滑出去好远，
两组划痕隔得很开。

现在的大象也这样。
过河的时候
身子沉在水里，
鼻子伸出水面，
脚在底下点着走。
pages.scene: One elephant wading across a deep river with only its head and back above the water, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这样的划痕
一共有好多道，
方向全都一样。
那天大概是一群恐龙，
一起过的河。
pages.scene: Many lines of toe-tip scratch marks on a river bottom all running the same way, seen from directly above. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
河底的泥后来干了，
又埋上一层沙，
一层一层压成石头。
那几道爪印
就这样留到今天。

我把手指
放进那道浅沟里。
它不是走过去的，
是浮着蹬过去的。
一千万年前的一步。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy crouching beside a slab of rock with three long scratch grooves in it, one finger resting inside a groove, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, thoughtful.
